set up beta regression with

```{r}
library(betareg)
library(glmmTMB)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)


run_betaregression <- function(df, response, design_vars = NULL) {
  
  y <- df[[response]]
  # Smithson & Verkuilen transformation to avoid 0 and 1 (not needed since is alrady bound by 0 and 1)
  #n <- length(y)
  #y_trans <- (y * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n
  
  df$y_beta <- y
  
  # Construct formula
  if (is.null(design_vars) || length(design_vars) == 0) {
    formula <- as.formula("y_beta ~ 1")
  } else {
    formula <- as.formula(
      paste("y_beta ~", paste(design_vars, collapse = " + "))
    )
  }
  
  # Run beta regression
  model <- betareg(formula, data = df)
  
  return(model)
}



run_betaregression_mixedeffect <- function(df, response, design_vars = NULL) {
  
  y <- df[[response]] 
  
  # Smithson & Verkuilen transformation to avoid 0 and 1
  #n <- length(y)
  #y_trans <- (y * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n
  
  df$y_beta <- y #y_trans
  
  # Construct formula
  if (is.null(design_vars) || length(design_vars) == 0) {
    formula <- as.formula("y_beta ~ 1")
  } else {
    formula <- as.formula(
      paste("y_beta ~", paste(design_vars, collapse = " + "))
    )
  }
  
  # Run beta regression
  model <- glmmTMB(formula, data = df, family = beta_family()
)
  
  return(model)
}



```



# Group Comparisons


```{r}
region_codes = data.frame(Region = c(21:27),
                          Region_name=c("Apex","LV-ant","LV-post","RV-post","LA","RA","Septum"))

database <- read.csv("~/ChagasCardiomyopathy_DATA_2026-03-07_1014.csv")

database$Patient <- database$study_id
database$Patient <- gsub("_", "", database$Patient)
database$Patient <- sub("-test$", "", database$Patient)


simple_database <- subset(database, redcap_event_name == "recruitment_arm_1")
simple_database <- subset(simple_database, select = c("Patient","sex","rec_age","b_eia_res"))

simple_database <- simple_database %>% 
  rename(Serology = b_eia_res) %>% 
  mutate( Disease = 
            case_when(Serology == 0 ~ "NCDCM",  
                      Serology == 1 ~ "CCC"),
          Disease = factor(Disease, levels = c("NCDCM", "CCC")),
          sex = case_when(
              sex == 0 ~ "M",
              sex == 1 ~ "F",
              TRUE ~ NA_character_
            ),
          sex = factor(sex))
```

```{r}
qupath_Bcell_counts <- read.csv("~/tissue_Bcell_summary_LVpost2.csv")

qupath_Bcell_counts$Image <- sub(".*?(COL)", "\\1", qupath_Bcell_counts$Image)
qupath_Bcell_counts$Patient <- sub("_.*", "", qupath_Bcell_counts$Image)

Bcell_counts <- qupath_Bcell_counts %>% 
  group_by(Patient) %>%
  summarise(
    total_area_mm2 = sum(TissueArea_um2)/1000000,
    total_cells = sum(TotalCells),
    CD20_only = sum(CD20_Only),
    CD79a_only = sum(CD79a_Only),
    CD20_CD79a = sum(CD20_CD79a_Both),
    B_cells = (CD20_CD79a + CD79a_only),
    CD20_per_mm2 = (CD20_only + CD20_CD79a) / total_area_mm2,
    CD79a_per_mm2 = (CD79a_only + CD20_CD79a) / total_area_mm2,
    Bcell_per_mm2 = (CD20_CD79a + CD20_only + CD79a_only) / total_area_mm2,
    proportion_CD20 = (CD20_only + CD20_CD79a) / total_cells,
    proportion_CD79a = (CD79a_only + CD20_CD79a)  / total_cells,
    proportion_Bcell = (CD20_CD79a + CD20_only + CD79a_only) / total_cells
  )


Bcell_counts <- merge(Bcell_counts, simple_database, all.x = TRUE, by = "Patient")

```

```{r}
##cannot do linear model. does not meet assumptions
#test <-lm(Bcell_per_mm2 ~ Disease, data = Bcell_counts)
#plot(test)

Bcell_area_model <- wilcox.test(CD79a_per_mm2 ~ Disease, data = Bcell_counts)
Bcell_area_stat <- data.frame(
  pval = round(Bcell_area_model$p.value, 3),
  sig = case_when(
    Bcell_area_model$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    Bcell_area_model$p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
    Bcell_area_model$p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE                             ~ "ns"
  ),
  group1 = "NCDCM",
  group2 = "CCC",
  y.position = max(Bcell_counts$Bcell_per_mm2, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
)



Bcell_prop_model <- run_betaregression(Bcell_counts, "proportion_CD79a", design_vars = c("Disease")) 

Bcell_prop_stat<-as.data.frame(summary(Bcell_prop_model)$coefficients$mean)

Bcell_prop_stat<- Bcell_prop_stat %>%
  filter(!rownames(.) == "(Intercept)") %>%
  rename( pval= `Pr(>|z|)`)%>%
  mutate(
         sig = case_when(
           pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
           pval < 0.01  ~ "**",
          pval < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE         ~ "ns"),
         pval = round(pval, 3),
         group1 = "NCDCM",
         group2 = "CCC",
         y.position = max(Bcell_counts$proportion_CD79a, na.rm = TRUE)*1.1)
```


```{r, fig.height =1.3, fig.width=2}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(Bcell_counts, aes(x = Disease, y = CD79a_per_mm2, fill = Disease)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7,  outliers = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(aes(shape = sex, color = Disease),
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0),
              size = 1.2, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phenocols)+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))+
  stat_pvalue_manual(Bcell_area_stat, label = "pval", size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = phenocols)+
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "B cells per mm2"
  ) 
ggsave("~/CD79a_per_mm2.pdf", height =1.3, width=2)


ggplot(Bcell_counts, aes(x = Disease, y = proportion_CD79a, fill = Disease)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7,  outliers = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(aes(shape = sex, color = Disease),
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0),
              size = 1.2, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phenocols)+
  scale_color_manual(values = phenocols)+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))+
  stat_pvalue_manual(Bcell_prop_stat, label = "pval", size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "B cells / all cells"
  ) 

ggsave("~/proportion_CD79a.pdf", height =1.3, width=2)



```


```{r, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=5}
library(tidyverse)
Bcell_props <- Bcell_counts %>%
  mutate(
    proportion_CD79a_only = CD79a_only / (CD79a_only + CD20_CD79a),
    proportion_CD20_CD79a = CD20_CD79a /(CD79a_only + CD20_CD79a)
  )

Bcell_props$proportion_Bcell<- NULL
Bcell_props$proportion_CD20 <- NULL
Bcell_props$proportion_CD79a <- NULL

Bcell_counts_long <- Bcell_props %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("proportion_"),
    names_to = "cell_type",
    values_to = "proportion"
  )


ggplot(Bcell_counts_long, aes(x = Patient, y = proportion, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ sex + Disease, scales = "free_x") +
   geom_text(data = Bcell_counts,
    aes(x = Patient, y = 1.05, label = B_cells),  # 1.05 puts it above bar
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2
  ) +  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.1))+
  labs(
    x = "Patient",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Cell type"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("orange","#ed2b2b")) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text =  element_text(size = 6)
  )

ggsave("~/proportion_of_CD79a.pdf", height =3.5, width=5)
```
